title: GitLab AI Provenance Evidence v0
description: Producer-side GitLab CI artifact recording declared AI involvement for a merge-request pipeline run. Schema: gitlab_ai_provenance_evidence.v0. AIIR is one possible producer; any conforming tool may emit this artifact.

schema.description: Schema identifier. MUST be the literal string 'gitlab_ai_provenance_evidence.v0'.

subject.description: GitLab pipeline context that produced this artifact.

change.description: Commit and diff covered by this artifact.

provenance.description: AI involvement declaration and detected signals.

receipt.description: AIIR receipt reference and verification status.

extensions.description: Optional forward-compatibility fields. Not part of the v0 core. Producers and consumers MUST ignore unknown extension keys.

Subject.description: Identifies the GitLab merge-request pipeline that produced this artifact.

kind.description: Subject kind. Fixed to 'gitlab.merge_request_pipeline' in v0.

project_full_path.description: GitLab project path (namespace/name), e.g. 'group/project'. Corresponds to CI_PROJECT_PATH.

merge_request_iid.description: Merge request internal ID within the project. Corresponds to CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID.

pipeline_id.description: GitLab pipeline ID. Corresponds to CI_PIPELINE_ID.

pipeline_sha.description: Full 40-character hex SHA of the commit the pipeline ran on. Corresponds to CI_COMMIT_SHA.

job_id.description: GitLab job ID. Corresponds to CI_JOB_ID.

job_name.description: GitLab job name. Corresponds to CI_JOB_NAME.

Change.description: Identifies the commit and diff covered by this artifact.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character hex SHA of the git commit.

diff_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full git diff: 'sha256:' + 64 hex chars. Matches the diff_hash field in the underlying AIIR commit receipt.

files_changed.description: List of changed file paths in the commit.

Provenance.description: AI involvement declaration and detected signals.

declared_ai_involvement.description: True if AIIR detected any AI signal in declared commit metadata (trailers, author fields, commit message body).

detection_boundary.description: Detection scope. Fixed to 'declared-metadata-only' in v0. AIIR does not detect hidden, undeclared, or copy-pasted AI usage.

signals.description: Raw signal strings found in declared commit metadata (e.g. 'Co-authored-by: Claude', 'AI-assisted'). Empty array when declared_ai_involvement is false.

Receipt.description: Reference to the underlying AIIR commit receipt and its verification status.

producer.description: Name of the tool that generated the underlying receipt. 'AIIR' for receipts generated by the AIIR CLI.

producer_version.description: Version of the producer tool (e.g. '1.5.1'). Use 'example' or a TODO marker when the version is not known at schema-authoring time.

mode.description: Receipt generation mode. 'declared-ai-receipt' for standard AIIR commit receipts.

receipt_id.description: AIIR receipt identifier. Format: 'g1-' followed by exactly 32 lowercase hex characters (content-addressed). Matches the receipt_id field in the underlying AIIR commit receipt.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the AIIR receipt core: 'sha256:' + 64 hex chars. Matches the content_hash field in the underlying AIIR commit receipt.

verification_status.description: Verification result for the underlying AIIR receipt. 'valid': content hash (and signature if present) verified. 'invalid': verification failed. 'unverified': no verification was performed in this pipeline run.

verified_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when verification was performed. MUST be omitted or null when verification_status is 'unverified'.

signed.description: True if the underlying AIIR receipt carries a Sigstore signature bundle.
